theorems.name: Submission.coarea_jacobian_linear_algebra
theorems.statement: (∀ (N m n : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), tangentSpace M x = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → (coareaJacobian M f x = 0 ↔ ¬ Function.Surjective ((fderiv ℝ f x).comp A))) ∧ ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x : Rn N) (A : WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k) →L[ℝ] Rn N) (B : Rn k →L[ℝ] Rn N), Function.Injective A → tangentSpace M x = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → (∀ p, fderiv ℝ f x (A p) = WithLp.fst p) → (∀ b, B b = A (WithLp.toLp 2 (0, b))) → coareaJacobian M f x * A.toLinearMap.normDet = B.toLinearMap.normDet
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
